question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Benevolent
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. **Generous**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Benevolent **means showing kindness or goodwill towards others **(दयालु)**.

 
 
• **Example: **The benevolent old man donated part of his wealth to charity.
 
 
 
• **Generous** means showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money, more than is necessary or expected **(उदार)**.
 
 
• **Example: **The generous person always offered to pay for his friends when they went out.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Generous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Innocent (निर्दोष)** means not guilty of a crime or offense; without any intent to cause harm.
 
• **Cruel (निर्दयी)** means willfully causing pain or suffering to others, or feeling no concern about it.
 
• **Wicked (दुष्ट) **refers to something evil or morally wrong.
